steps.label: SERVICE MENU  /  STEP 01
steps.heading: Open your services
steps.benefit: Tap Services to manage your booking menu.

steps.label: SERVICE MENU  /  STEP 02
steps.heading: Add a new service
steps.benefit: Tap + Service to add a treatment to your menu.

steps.label: SERVICE MENU  /  STEP 03
steps.heading: Set the service essentials
steps.benefit: Add a clear name, price and appointment length.

steps.label: SERVICE MENU  /  STEP 04
steps.heading: Save your new service
steps.benefit: Tap Save Service to add it to your menu.

steps.label: SERVICE MENU  /  STEP 05
steps.heading: Keep your prices current
steps.benefit: Tap Edit and enter your updated price.

steps.label: SERVICE MENU  /  STEP 06
steps.heading: Confirm your new price
steps.benefit: Tap Update Service to save the change.

steps.label: SERVICE MENU  /  STEP 07
steps.heading: Choose your add-ons
steps.benefit: Let clients choose extras with their manicure.

steps.label: SERVICE MENU  /  STEP 08
steps.heading: French tips & chrome
steps.benefit: Select finishes with clear extra prices and time.

steps.label: SERVICE MENU  /  STEP 09
steps.heading: Add glitter & removal
steps.benefit: Add removal from another salon when needed.

steps.label: SERVICE MENU  /  STEP 10
steps.heading: Save your chosen extras
steps.benefit: Tap Done to save the extras for this service.

steps.label: YOUR SERVICE MENU
steps.heading: Your menu, clearly booked
steps.benefit: Help clients choose the right appointment.
